name: local-docker
description: Local Solace PubSub+ in Docker - VPN aem-local from local/terragrunt - user aem-suite may publish everywhere (password aemsuite)

name: local-docker (publisher)
description: Same broker as user aem-publisher - may only publish below aem/ (password publisher)

name: local-docker (subscriber)
description: Same broker as user aem-subscriber - may not publish at all, so every test fails with Publish ACL Denied (password subscriber)

name: local-docker (ask for user)
description: Same broker without a username - username and password are asked for when running (aem-suite/aemsuite, aem-publisher/publisher or aem-subscriber/subscriber)

name: aem-dev (destination)
description: Example for DESTINATION mode - provide destination "aem-dev" and activate
